summary: Frontend-only e2e test of PawClean static landing page (Playwright, Chromium). 51/55 initial checks passed; 4 'failures' were re-verified and confirmed to be test-script timing/assertion issues, not real product bugs. All required features work correctly.
verified_features: Page title = 'PawClean — Des pattes propres en 10 secondes' (set via useEffect)
All 10 data-testid sections present: pawclean-root, section-hero, section-how, section-product, section-before-after, section-features, section-reviews, section-delivery, section-faq, section-footer
hero-headline shows 'Des pattes propres' and 'en dix secondes.'
hero-cta exists with href='#product' and triggers smooth anchor scroll to product section (verified separately — scrollY changed by ~5000px towards target)
Custom cursor (ring + dot) present on desktop viewport
Color swatches (sage, sky, terracotta) each click updates displayed color name to Vert forêt / Bleu brume / Terracotta
Size tags S/M/L update product-price to 18€ / 21€ / 23€ respectively (verified after 1200ms wait to allow framer-motion AnimatePresence exit animation of 450ms to complete)
Active size tag has kraft-paper class with -rotate-[3deg] (visually confirmed via screenshot — L tag is rotated and on textured background)
product-buy-cta href changes correctly: S → 7sY8wH..., M → 00weV5..., L → 4gM4gr...
Before/After section shows 'VS' badge text and 2 background-image visuals (Unsplash CSS background-image, no tags)
6 faq-item-0..5 present; clicking trigger expands content (Radix Accordion data-state='open' confirmed)
Mobile responsive at 375px: horizontal overflow = 0px, hero headline visible, sections stack properly
false_positives_explanation: Initial 'price swap' failures (S→21€, M→18€): caused by Playwright reading inner_text during framer-motion AnimatePresence mode='wait' exit animation (450ms) with only 400ms test wait. Re-test with 1200ms wait showed correct prices S=18€, M=21€, L=23€. NOT a real bug.

Initial 'anchor scroll' failure: test assumed scroll direction was downward; in reality previous test actions had scrolled past product, so clicking #product correctly scrolled UPWARD to the section (scrollY 6905 → 1928 which IS the product section). Anchor scroll works correctly.
Initial 'Before/After 0 images': section uses CSS background-image URLs (Unsplash) rather than tags. 2 URLs confirmed via computed style. Valid implementation.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: ProductSelector uses AnimatePresence mode='wait' on the price element — this briefly removes the data-testid='product-price' element during transition. Consider keeping the wrapper stable and animating only inner content if you want easier automated price assertions.
Minor: Before/After section uses CSS background-image — acceptable but adds no alt text; consider role='img' with aria-label for accessibility.
All other code is clean: env vars used correctly (no hardcoded URLs), data-testid coverage is excellent, Stripe links centralized in pawclean-data.js.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static landing page, no backend. When testing size selector, wait ≥600ms after clicking due to framer-motion AnimatePresence mode='wait' exit animation (450ms) on the product-price element. Before/After section uses CSS background-image, not . The page is long (~7000px); use scrollIntoView before clicking elements below the fold.
rca of the issue: No real bugs found. All 4 initial 'failures' were test-script artifacts (timing too short for exit animation, wrong assumption about scroll direction, wrong expectation of tags vs CSS bg-image). After re-verification with proper waits, all features behave per spec.
